findings.highlight: Still, I tried to save Saber not out of some foolishly optimistic belief I could.
findings.evidenceJa: それでもセイバーを助けようとしたのは、もしかしたら助かるかもしれない、なんて楽観を持っていたからじゃない。
findings.governingReading: He tried to save her without optimistically thinking he himself might survive.
findings.explanation: Survival optimism loses its object and can become rescue optimism.

findings.evidenceJa: 「……つまり。ただ自然に、私を助けようとしたのですね」
findings.governingReading: Saber reads his attempt to save her as a spontaneous/natural response; he denies that and claims confusion.
findings.explanation: A natural attempt to help becomes acting unwittingly.

findings.highlight: I try to mask my anxiety by just spouting a bunch of heartless crap.
findings.evidenceJa: 心にもない言葉で、懸命にはね除けた。
findings.governingReading: He desperately repels her warning with insincere words promising to prioritize himself.
findings.explanation: Words he does not mean become heartless crap masking anxiety.
